second_run_result: The selected case e-006 passed all five runs after the revert, so the intentional regression was removed. The job still failed because two other regression cases, e-008 and e-009, each failed one of five runs by printing a raw record field. explanation: The temporary instruction was scoped to restocking fee answers, so only e-006 depends on it. Run 1 blocked on e-006 (0 of 5) as intended. Run 2 restored e-006 (5 of 5) and blocked on e-008 and e-009 instead. Both are raw_record_fields_in_reply cases that passed 5 of 5 at baseline but were rebuilt from Homework 4 conversations where the agent had failed, so their baseline reliability was always below 1. Across three evaluations (baseline, run 1, run 2) e-009 passed 13 of 15 and e-008 passed 14 of 15, which matches the handout's point that a regression case passing five times does not guarantee future runs pass; with four regression cases and a per-run reliability near 0.9 for these two, a fully green run is the exception rather than the rule.
